title: Calculate space
summary: Less can calculate a size from other sizes.
introduction: Less can calculate a size from other sizes. Your task: Change space to 20px and calculate both results.
learningObjectives: Change space to 20px and calculate both results.
Explain the example for calculate space

blocks.text: Less can calculate a size from other sizes. Parentheses make the calculation clear, especially when dividing.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
Read the code step by step

items: The parentheses make division explicit: 24 divided by 2 is 12, while adding 4 gives 28.

blocks.text: The result uses 12px padding and 28px margin.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep units compatible. Adding a time in seconds to a length in pixels does not make a useful CSS size.

blocks.text: Change space to 20px and calculate both results.
